question: Can the prospectively frozen 120-test strict absolute-deadline protocol be migrated into Process Receipt V3 while preserving byte-identical legacy receipts and the already-green 113-test current hostile frontier?

groups.observed: ChildIdentityBound exposes only child_pid, process_group_id, and deadline_monotonic_ns; the strict oracle requires invocation_occurrence_id, deadline_binding_hash, and a derived child_occurrence_id.
Strict subjects/invocations accept empty or legacy-only traces that must fail closed, while legacy receipts must remain byte-identical in their own reducer lane.
Strict events are rejected when relinked to the legacy lane, but the failure knowledge/message does not identify the strict-to-legacy authority violation required by the oracle.
A failed PROCESS_START whose post-return observation reaches the deadline does not retain TIMEOUT knowledge while correctly retaining no child and no successful process-start work.

red_census.rule: These are the currently visible root groups. After each repair, newly exposed failures must be classified and repaired recursively; the executor may not stop merely because the first 78 failures changed shape.

implementation_scope.exact_copy_rule: tests/unit/kernel/test_process_receipt_v3_deadline_hostile.py must be copied byte-for-byte from archive blob 55b3399b3c732a4b8303799be28ffef2439f0e5b and retain SHA-256 103c3678e34ea33b7657bec911c8d604b97196bdbf56df40df3f4d2ab8cc051d. Editing the oracle is forbidden.
forbidden_paths_and_classes: P1 finalizer, Slurm, LUNARC, custody, integrity, and immutable-OID paths
xfail, skip, timeout widening, denominator reduction, or assertion weakening

child_identity_dual_dialect: Preserve the original first three ChildIdentityBound positional fields and byte-identical legacy payload behavior when strict coordinates are absent.
Add a complete all-or-none strict coordinate set containing invocation_occurrence_id, deadline_binding_hash, and child_occurrence_id.
In the strict lane, derive child_occurrence_id from exact invocation, deadline binding, child PID, process group, and deadline coordinates; do not accept a caller-declared occurrence identity.
Reject incomplete or contradictory strict coordinates and rederive them during replay.
strict_legacy_lane_separation: A strict subject and strict materialized invocation cannot build or verify an empty, legacy-only, or unbound-result trace.
A legacy subject/invocation remains accepted only by the legacy reducer and preserves the frozen P0 hashes and serialization.
Strict events cannot be relinked into a legacy invocation or reducer, and legacy events cannot gain strict authority by reducer relabeling.
The strict/legacy discriminator must be derived from the closed subject/invocation coordinates, not a free caller Boolean.
process_start_protocol: DeadlineBinding is the PRE observation for PROCESS_START.
ProcessStartCompletion is mandatory POST knowledge for successful and failed start attempts.
A successful start binds the exact child between attempt and completion; a failed start invents no child.
Completion-time deadline crossing retains the completed start attempt, latches TIMEOUT, and forbids later MAIN external effects.
Failed start crossing retains primary start failure plus timeout knowledge, while git_process_starts remains zero.
effect_protocol: After a strict child exists, every external MAIN effect follows DeadlineAdmission(PRE), one exact effect attempt/result, and DeadlineCompletion(POST).
Admissions and completions bind exact event-chain positions, invocation, child, deadline, clock-domain occurrence, stage, target, and attempt ordinal.
EINTR cannot reset the original deadline; selector semantic waits cannot exceed exact remaining time; completion crossing is irreversible.
POST-before-effect, result-after-crossing, clock regression, forged select arguments, and occurrence relinking fail closed.

recursive_red_green_rule: Preserve the exact 120-test oracle before implementation.
For each visible failure group, retain a minimal failing node id and semantic diagnosis.
Implement the smallest semantics-preserving repair in process_receipt.py.
Run the focused node, then the complete deadline oracle, then the complete 233-test combined denominator.
Any newly exposed RED re-enters the same classification loop; no post-outcome test edit is allowed.
The two final combined-suite runs must have identical collected node ids and zero failures, errors, skips, xfails, or flaky reruns.

must_bind: process_receipt.py blob and SHA-256 before and after
all four exact test-file blobs and SHA-256 values
120-test deadline denominator and 233-test combined denominator node ids
all intermediate RED classifications and final zero-failure runs
legacy reference hashes and strict reducer/replay identities
commands, environment, exit codes, logs, XML reports, byte counts, and SHA-256 values

requirements: The exact deadline oracle is 120/120 GREEN.
The current core/public, historical-17, and wait/finalization suites remain 113/113 GREEN.
The combined denominator is exactly 233 unique node ids and is GREEN in two clean processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED values.
Legacy P0 receipt/event serialization and frozen reference hashes are byte-identical.
No test, denominator, timeout, retry cap, work cap, output cap, authority ceiling, or negative receipt is weakened.
